verses: When I put forth the second footstep, it was to Hukht of the moon track, the place where good words find hospitality; and I saw a great assembly of the pious.
And I asked Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, thus: 'Which place is this? and whose are those souls?'

Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This place is the moon track; and these are those souls who, in the world, offered no prayers, and chanted no Gathas, and contracted no next-of-kin marriages; but through other good works they have come hither; and their brightness is like unto the brightness of the moon.'
